music.name: Bare Maximum
music.why: A low-key start to the week at one of San Francisco's most established neighborhood bars.
music.summary: Bare Maximum is a Monday-night event at The Lone Star Saloon, the long-running SoMa bear bar on Harrison Street. Doors open at 7pm.

music.name: Bobby McFerrin & Motion
music.why: A rare chance to sing in a circle with a 10-time Grammy winner on a Monday noon — joyful, improvised and no experience needed.
music.summary: Bobby McFerrin leads his weekly Circlesongs session with the vocal group MOTION at The Freight, a midday sing-along open to all voices.

music.name: Freakyoke 11/2
music.why: Free karaoke on a Monday night at a beloved Oakland dive, a zero-cost way to sing with a friendly crowd.
music.summary: Freakyoke is Thee Stork Club's Monday karaoke night in Oakland: free entry, 21+, doors and singing from 8pm.

music.name: Halloween Leftovers
music.why: The post-Halloween comedown for the darker crowd: costumes optional, gothic, industrial and synthpop on two floors, and cover that never tops $8.
music.summary: Death Guild's Monday goth/industrial night goes Halloween-leftovers: six DJs across two rooms at DNA Lounge, with Decay (Chicago), Joe Radio (Bogotá) and Sage (Amarillo) on the bill. 18+.

music.name: Lee Ritenour
music.why: For an evening of focused live music.
music.summary: Lee Ritenour performs at 510 Embarcadero West in Oakland on November 2, 2026 at 7pm; tickets are $45–$89.

music.name: Lexi Jayde
music.why: An intimate, all-ages live set at one of SF's best mid-size rooms to start the week.
music.summary: Lexi Jayde plays The Independent on Divisadero on a Monday night, doors-to-show at 7:30pm, all ages.

music.name: LUCY (Cooper B. Handy) and Nation
music.why: A Monday-night live set from LUCY and Nation at the Mission's Kilowatt, an easy way to start the week with live music.
music.summary: Live show at Kilowatt in the Mission: LUCY (Cooper B. Handy) with Nation, doors at 7pm, 21+.

music.name: Madre Cumbia
music.why: To dance to upbeat cumbia and Latin rhythms.
music.summary: Madre Cumbia takes place on November 2, 2026 at 7:30pm at 859 O'Farrell Street in San Francisco; tickets are $30–$34.

music.name: "Motown On Mondays" DJ Night (Madrone Art Bar)
music.why: A free weeknight DJ party for dancing to Motown-era soul and R&B grooves.
music.summary: A Motown On Mondays DJ night at Madrone Art Bar on November 2, 2026, running 7pm–2am. Admission is free.
